caseName: California Department of Corrections v. Morales
caseNameFull: California Department of Corrections v. Ramon Morales

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 1287.] Application for stay, presented to Justice O’Connor, and by her referred to the Court, granted, and it is ordered that the mandate of the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, case No. 92-56262, is stayed pending the sending down of the judgment of this Court.
